summary: The customer called to complain about a rude previous agent who yelled and hung up on them, and also to resolve an unexpected double billing issue on their account. The agent apologized, registered a formal complaint against the previous agent, verified the billing error, and processed a credit adjustment. The call ended with the customer satisfied with the current agent's help while still expecting a supervisor callback.

evidence.text: رح أسجل طلب call back من الـ supervisor بأقرب وقت ممكن اليوم.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Arrange a callback from a supervisor today.

evidence.text: راح تنزل المبلغ بحسابك خلال ساعتين.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Credit adjustment amount will appear in the account within two hours.

compliance_flags.description: The agent used slightly informal and scolding language ('عيب عليك') towards the customer.

evidence.text: يا أستاذ بعتذر منك كتير، شو اللي صار معك بالظبط؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent repeatedly apologized and validated the customer's frustration regarding the previous agent's behavior.

evidence.text: لا أبداً عيب عليك، أنا حاضر أساعدك بكل إشي بدك إياه بخصوص الفاتورة،
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: Mostly professional and polite, though lowered slightly due to using colloquial pushback ('عيب عليك').

evidence.text: وأنا هلأ عملت credit adjustment وراح تنزل المبلغ بحسابك خلال ساعتين.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully identified the double billing and processed a credit adjustment to resolve the core issue.

evidence.text: بس ضروري أعرف الحساب عشان أقدر أعمل formal complaint وأرفعها للإدارة.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: Clear explanations of what steps were being taken for both the complaint and the billing issue.

evidence.text: الله يسلمك أستاذ، نهارك سعيد ومعتذر مرة ثانية، أهلاً بك.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: Closed the call politely with another apology, confirming no further assistance was needed.

evidence.text: وفعلاً في غلطة بالفاتورة وصار في double billing بالخطأ.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: Accurately identified the double billing error on the system.

evidence.text: ممكن تعطيني رقم الخط أو الـ account number عشان أقدر أشوف السجل؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: Followed proper procedure by requesting the account number to access records and file the complaint.

quote.text: أنا مش مبسوط بالمرة من الخدمة اللي تلقيتها قبل شوي
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: I want a callback from a supervisor today to confirm what action you took!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: طيب، وشكراً لإلك أنت بالذات لأنك متعاون،
quote.speaker: Customer
